answer: Trust can flow like a ripple from a few audited seed agents: each epoch, short random walks spread reputation along real work-trade edges, and an agent earns only what reaches it. A sybil swarm gets just the ember that leaks through its few links to honest agents, so a thousand fakes split a trickle. To gain more, the attacker must win genuine trades with honest peers, which costs real work. Reputation is the jade here: slow to grow, hard to fake.
